data.body: Fixed by Gerrit change 3138 patch set 2 (merged; LLM-Review+1, Verified+1). A rejected non-fast-forward batch push now union-merges the remote, re-repairs the batch on the merged state, commits, and retries, up to 3 pushes; other failures or a persistent rejection still abort naming the batch, with the pre-tag kept. Pushes use the configured tickets remote/branch. Tests: real two-clone integration race (clean fsck, concurrent comment kept, local == remote; fails on ORPHAN_EVENT without the re-repair), a bare-remote store test, and a retry-budget test. make verify 19827 passed; integration tier 189 passed.
